title: Make the full-gate launcher bootstrap private UI dependencies from its lockfile
outcome: A clean candidate worktree needs no manual ui/node_modules preparation: full launcher prepares declared locked UI dependencies before TypeScript/Vitest, and bootstrap failure has distinct terminal preflight setup evidence before any stage runs.
acceptance: A full-gate invocation with no ui/node_modules prepares declared UI dependencies from the candidate's committed lockfile before TypeScript or Vitest stages, without manual Merger setup.
Bootstrap failure produces distinct terminal preflight setup evidence and does not start TypeScript/Vitest or claim a running/passed gate.

Focused fresh-worktree bootstrap ordering and failure regressions pass; a fresh independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding; exact package/test/review evidence is handed to Merger.
